date.source: The promotion's own recap dates the event 27 June 1999; posted 12 July 1999.

matches.note: Unforgiven reversed a choke slam attempt for the pin, then was attacked with a steel chair by Chaple after the bell.
A number-one-contender's match; Zoran abandoned his partner Firestalker, who was forced to submit to Cobra's Cobra Clutch.
First-round tournament match; Unforgiven won with a four-corners choke slam despite wrestling hurt from the chair shot.
First-round tournament match; Archangel won with his "Elevator to Hell" finisher after ejecting Unknown Wrestler's manager, Mr. G, from ringside.
First-round tournament match; Devestation won with his "Devestator" running powerbomb after the referee barred his Hoodlam allies from ringside.
First-round tournament match, won by disqualification after "Big D" Devestation hit American Made with a steel chair.
Semifinal; the two friends fought to a knocked-out referee before Chaple's hidden chair shot let Archangel pin an unwitting Unforgiven.
Semifinal; Tak allowed the pin and was revealed as the newest member of the Dungeon of Devestation.
UWF Tag Team Championship; Hoodlam retained after Mighty Tak's pre-match sneak attack left Cowboy Jack half-conscious.
UWF Ultimate Championship final; Archangel escaped a "Devestator" attempt and rolled Devestation up for the pin to become the promotion's first-ever Ultimate Champion.
